column1: # Uberon label -> the words O'Rahilly & Muller (1987) actually use, pipe-separated.
# Why this file is load-bearing: searching the book for an Uberon label and
# getting nothing looks exactly like the book being silent on the subject. It
# usually is not. O'Rahilly states outright that "the term placode is avoided",
# writes "mesoblast" where modern usage has mesoderm, "process" where we say
# prominence, and "upper/lower limb" for fore/hindlimb. Without this map, a
# search for "lens placode" returns zero hits in a book that discusses the lens
# Every form below was found in the built corpus before being written here --
# none are guesses. Add to it the same way: probe the corpus, confirm the form
# occurs, then record it. A speculative synonym that matches nothing is
# harmless; one that matches the wrong structure is not.

column2: vagal crest|vagal-accessory neural crest|cervical neural crest
medial nasal process|lateral nasal process|nasal field
lateral striatal ridge|medial striatal ridge|striatal field
aortic arch 6|sixth aortic arch|pulmonary aortic arch
aortic arch system|pharyngeal arches|caudal pharyngeal complex

column1: # --- Terms confirmed ABSENT from the corpus -----------------------------------
# Probed and found nowhere in the 1987 text. Listed so a future curator does not
# repeat the search and so a zero-hit result is distinguishable from an
# unexplored one. Absence here means "this book does not use these words", NOT
# "this structure does not exist at these stages" -- go to another source.
#   heart tube          (O'Rahilly describes "the two endocardial tubes" and
#   ductus arteriosus   (post-embryonic emphasis; not named in stages 1-23)
#   myotome             (dermatome and sclerotome appear; myotome does not)
#   limb field          (no "field" usage for limbs; see limb bud)
#   mammary placode     (only "mammary crest" -- the ridge, not the placode)
#   pharyngeal arch 6   (the book names arches 1-4; the 6th is not discussed)
#   limb bud mesenchyme (the book writes of limb-bud mesoblast in passing only)
# O'Rahilly & Muller 1987 covers the EMBRYONIC period: Carnegie stages 1-23,
# ending ~56-60 postovulatory days. Anything fetal is not in this corpus and
# cannot be checked against it at all. From the current axiom table that means:
# alveolus of lung, lung saccule, brown adipose tissue, vernix caseosa,
# cerebral cortex subventricular zone, cortical preplate, cortical subplate,
# nephrogenic zone, primary ossification center, secondary ossification center.
# Do not read "no hits" for these as disagreement with the source.
